_about: emOS is EchoMuse's (wilbowes/EchoMuse, emos/, by Wil Bowes and the EchoMuse contributors). EchoHome's tests read these files, at this commit, where its code must agree with emOS; tools/fetch_emos_ref.py fetches them into .emos-ref/. Move the pin with the emOS release the setup tool installs: change commit and tag, then run it with --update.
